composition.title: Supply collaborators, then deliver a message
composition.summary: The lesson ASCII sketch describes dependencies and call order. In the runnable remind function the message formatting is inline, rather than a separate formatter object.

nodes.label: Entry point
nodes.description: The application supplies title and a delivery callable.

nodes.label: remind
nodes.description: The focused function coordinates this reminder.

nodes.label: Message formatting
nodes.description: Build Review Patterns in the function.

nodes.label: Delivery callable
nodes.description: sent.append is the supplied local delivery implementation.

nodes.label: Recorded message
nodes.description: The local sent list contains Review Patterns.

steps.title: Assemble the dependency
steps.explanation: The caller supplies delivery; remind does not locate a global service.

steps.title: Build a message
steps.explanation: The runnable function formats its text inline and passes that text to delivery.

steps.title: Observe delivery
steps.explanation: The assertion checks the recorded local message, not a real network delivery.

factories.title: Select one formatter at the boundary
factories.summary: This is the lesson simple factory. A selection function is not automatically the class-based Factory Method or Abstract Factory pattern.

nodes.label: Format name
nodes.description: The caller supplies json or lines.

nodes.label: formatter_for
nodes.description: The bounded selection function checks the format name.

nodes.label: JSON callable
nodes.description: The json option returns a callable using json.dumps.

nodes.label: Lines callable
nodes.description: The lines option returns a callable joining titles.

nodes.label: Unknown format error
nodes.description: An unsupported name raises ValueError.

nodes.label: Consumer
nodes.description: The caller invokes the selected callable with titles.

steps.title: Name the variation
steps.explanation: Construction/selection chooses a formatter separately from using it.

steps.title: Choose one supported option
steps.explanation: Known names return one compatible callable; unknown names fail explicitly.

steps.title: Use the chosen implementation
steps.explanation: The consumer supplies titles to that callable. Do not interpret format names as executable code.

builder.title: Validate construction before freezing a snapshot
builder.summary: The mutable builder holds temporary choices. The finished Report receives a tuple snapshot so later builder edits do not change it.

nodes.label: Builder choices
nodes.description: Builder().field(title) records a selected field in a mutable list.

nodes.label: build title
nodes.description: build receives Progress with surrounding spaces.

nodes.label: Validate choices
nodes.description: Reject blank titles, missing fields or blank field names.

nodes.label: Frozen Report
nodes.description: Return a trimmed title and tuple(self.fields); later adding minutes to the builder does not alter r.fields.

steps.title: build title

steps.title: Validate choices

steps.title: Frozen Report

facade.title: Publish succeeds only after delivery
facade.summary: The facade offers one entry point across validation, formatting and delivery. It does not make these collaborators transactional.

nodes.label: publish caller
nodes.description: Supply titles plus formatting and delivery collaborators.

nodes.label: Validate all titles
nodes.description: Reject invalid titles before invoking the formatter.

nodes.label: Format document
nodes.description: The formatter returns a document.

nodes.label: Deliver document
nodes.description: Call delivery; meaningful failure propagates.

nodes.label: Return count
nodes.description: Return len(titles) only after delivery succeeds.

steps.title: Format document

steps.title: Return count

composite.title: One duration operation across leaves and groups
composite.summary: The lesson plan is a finite acyclic tree. Groups sum child durations; a shared node would be counted for each occurrence.

nodes.label: Root Module
nodes.description: The root contains Lesson(10) and a nested Module.

nodes.label: Lesson: 10
nodes.description: This leaf returns 10 minutes.

nodes.label: Nested Module
nodes.description: The nested group sums its one child.

nodes.label: Lesson: 20
nodes.description: This leaf returns 20 minutes.

nodes.label: Root result: 30
nodes.description: The root sums 10+20.

steps.title: Use the same operation
steps.explanation: The root calls duration on both a leaf and a group.

steps.title: Recurse through the group
steps.explanation: The nested Module obtains and sums its child duration.

steps.title: Combine results
steps.explanation: The root receives 10 and 20 and returns 30. Empty modules sum to zero.

proxy.title: Loaded is distinct from a cached None
proxy.summary: The lesson local proxy caches a successful load once. A failed load leaves it unloaded; no invalidation or concurrency guarantee is supplied.

nodes.label: get caller
nodes.description: A caller requests the local document.

nodes.label: loaded flag?
nodes.description: Check the separate flag rather than testing value truthiness.

nodes.label: Call loader
nodes.description: If unloaded, invoke load; failure propagates before the flag changes.

nodes.label: Store value and flag
nodes.description: After success, store even None and set loaded=True.

nodes.label: Return cached value
nodes.description: Return value; later calls use it without loading again.

steps.title: Check loading status
steps.explanation: The flag decides whether to call the loader.

steps.title: Cache successful completion
steps.explanation: The example loader returns None successfully, which is still a cacheable result.

steps.title: Reuse the result
steps.explanation: A later get sees loaded=True and returns None without another loader call.

chain-of-responsibility.title: First non-None result wins
chain-of-responsibility.summary: The lesson JSON request passes through ordered handlers. None declines; False and empty strings are valid accepted results. Exceptions propagate.

nodes.label: Request
nodes.description: format=json and titles=[Patterns].

nodes.label: Lines handler
nodes.description: Declines this JSON request with None.

nodes.label: JSON handler
nodes.description: Returns the JSON representation.

nodes.label: Accepted result
nodes.description: Return immediately after a non-None result.

nodes.label: No accepting handler
nodes.description: If every handler declines, raise LookupError.

steps.title: Try handlers in order
steps.explanation: For the example, lines declines and JSON is tried next.

steps.title: Stop on explicit acceptance
steps.explanation: A non-None result ends selection, even if it is False or an empty string. JSON succeeds here.

steps.title: Keep failure explicit
steps.explanation: If the whole chain declines, LookupError reports unhandled input. Handler exceptions never mean automatic fallback.

state.title: Legal study-session transitions
state.summary: Edges are legal action transitions from the lesson table. Other state/action pairs raise ValueError; this lifecycle supplies no concurrency control.

nodes.label: draft
nodes.description: The initial session state.

nodes.label: active
nodes.description: start enters active; pause leaves it.

nodes.label: done
nodes.description: finish from active enters done.

nodes.label: Illegal action
nodes.description: A state/action pair missing from the table raises ValueError.

steps.title: Start a session
steps.explanation: draft plus start returns active.

steps.title: Pause or finish
steps.explanation: active can pause back to draft or finish to done.

steps.title: Reject an absent transition
steps.explanation: Finishing from draft is illegal; the table supplies no outgoing transition from done.

mediator.title: Validate before state and notification effects
mediator.summary: CompletionMediator owns local collaboration rules. Failed prerequisites, missing IDs and repeated completion leave states and notifications unchanged.

nodes.label: Completion request
nodes.description: The caller asks to complete a lesson.

nodes.label: Validate active and prerequisites
nodes.description: Require a known active lesson and completed prerequisites.

nodes.label: Reject request
nodes.description: Validation failure raises without changing local state or notifications.

nodes.label: Set done
nodes.description: Successful validation permits the local state transition.

nodes.label: Record notification
nodes.description: Append one local completed notification after the successful transition.

steps.title: Check before effects
steps.explanation: Trying next before intro fails and preserves both collections.

steps.title: Apply a legal completion
steps.explanation: Completing intro, then next, passes their prerequisites and sets each done.

steps.title: Record successful outcomes
steps.explanation: Each successful transition has one local notification. External delivery would need a separate contract.

dependency-injection.title: Assemble dependencies at the entry point
dependency-injection.summary: The lesson Progress service receives save and clock explicitly. These arrows describe supplied collaborators and calls, not inheritance.

nodes.label: Composition root
nodes.description: Create Progress(records.append, fixed clock). The root supplies the implementations.

nodes.label: Progress.complete

nodes.label: Construct record
nodes.description: Build title plus the clock value; the test clock makes time deterministic.

nodes.label: Save collaborator
nodes.description: Call records.append with that record. The assertion checks the recorded time.

steps.title: Construct record

unit-of-work.title: Publish the working copy only on success
unit-of-work.summary: The lesson and workshop copy-on-write flow is local and sequential. Dictionary clear/update is not a database transaction, crash-safe commit or atomic concurrent operation.

nodes.label: Original store
nodes.description: The original begins with completed=0.

nodes.label: Working copy
nodes.description: Create an independent working representation.

nodes.label: Mutate working state
nodes.description: Set completed=1 in the working copy.

nodes.label: Publish copy
nodes.description: After normal body return, clear/update replaces original contents sequentially. Replacement itself has no crash-safe or concurrent atomicity guarantee.

nodes.label: Preserve original
nodes.description: If the body raises, publishing is skipped; original stays completed=0.

steps.title: Isolate proposed changes
steps.explanation: Mutate the working copy rather than the original store.

steps.title: Publish normal completion
steps.explanation: Only the successful body reaches clear/update and publishes completed=1. These two local dictionary operations are not an atomic storage commit; real persistence needs a transaction and conflict policy.

steps.title: Keep failure unpublished
steps.explanation: A ValueError raised in the body prevents those replacement statements from running.

refactoring.title: Keep the same regression suite between extractions
refactoring.summary: The refactoring lab repeatedly checks observable output, failure timing and success-only measurement. The diagram is the sequence of learner edits.

nodes.label: Characterize starter
nodes.description: Run test_refactoring.py against legacy behavior and create a scratch candidate.
